title: Yoga for a Cause - benefitting Give Like a Mother
description: Join us for an all-levels yoga class to benefit the mission of Give Like a Mother - Clothing Kids in Confidence
long_description:
Join us for an all-levels yoga class to benefit the mission of Give Like a Mother - Clothing Kids in Confidence

About this Event

Come flow with us to benefit Give Like a Mother. Give Like A Mother (GLAM) is a nonprofit dedicated to ensuring that local children and teens in need have access to seasonally appropriate clothing.
Though we operate on donations of gently used items, we are committed to providing high-quality, in-style clothing that kids can wear with confidence. When children feel good about what they’re wearing, it can boost their self-worth, reduce the risk of ridicule, and ultimately support their success in school and beyond.
Our name may be fun and a little sassy, but it carries a serious challenge. Mothers give everything they can for their children—yet sometimes, even that isn’t enough.
That’s why we’re asking you: Will you Give Like A Mother and help a child in need?
100% of all donations go directly to the charity. We thank Fretboard Brewing for donating the space and Anissa Dowling for donating her time and talent in leading the yoga class that is always fun and perfect for all levels.
Bring a friend and enjoy $1 off beers in the tap room after class!

Also check out other in Cincinnati, Workshops in Cincinnati, Health & Wellness events in Cincinnati.
